$comment: Frozen P0 IPC contract between the Rust voice-changer plugin (P0-A) and the TS VoiceChangerService (P0-B), written by P0-S0; extended for the Sigil Voice Engine by P3-S0 ('p3_new' entries and the *_p3_* sections) and for the voice families by P5-S0 (the *_p5_* sections and 'families').
Rust reads it in its tests (include_str!) and src/core/services/voice_changer/__tests__/params.test.ts reads it, so the normalize lists on both sides match (no silent option remapping).

'existing' = what Rust accepts today (set_voice_changer_params). 'p0_new' = fields P0-A adds to VoiceChangerParams / VoiceChangerMetrics and P0-B sends / shows; until P0-A lands, Rust ignores unknown params fields and TS must treat the new metrics fields as optional.

'baseline' = the values every build runs; the other values of an enum run once their workstream lands (voice_changer_get_capabilities lists what this build runs; until then a value runs its 'stand_in' / 'base'). The UI offers only baseline values plus what the capabilities list.
Params travel snake_case (serde field names). Change only through an INTEGRATE step.

rvc_preset.$comment: studio_trt (P3): Quality shapes on TensorRT-RTX; offered when voice_changer_get_capabilities lists it. default_ep is the EP an unset rvc_execution_provider asks for.

pitch_extractor.$comment: P3-S0: swiftf0 / crepe (a real CREPE-tiny; it was an alias of rmvpe until P3) / pesto / fusion are values of their own; while this build cannot run one it runs its stand_in (then the gpu_only rule), with an rvc_warning.

rvc_execution_provider.$comment: Rust normalize_execution_provider: case-insensitive, trimmed; '' = preset default (enums.rvc_preset.default_ep). P3 accelerators: sessions build on 'base' (the EP ladder rung) and the accelerator is added only when available.

aux_mic_gate.$comment: What happens to the mic while aux (TTS) audio plays through the voice changer. 'none' = today's mix.

precision.$comment: Graph precision of template voices; auto = layout.json's recommendation per graph and device class (ADR 0004).

lever_mode.$comment: Mode of every lever in 'levers'. auto = the preset's benchmark-decided default (engine::presets::auto_lever; off until measured); on = run it when this build and the EP can, else the legacy path with a note; off = legacy path.

f0_range.$comment: speech = 50-1100 Hz (legacy); singing = up to 2.5 kHz (P3-D). Per voice.

latency_budget_ms.$comment: Backlog above this is dropped oldest-first (whole blocks, exact length accounting); applies to every mode and the sidecar read timeout.

block_ms.$comment: SVE block (ms); 0 = derived from chunk_frames (legacy harness); the engine rounds up to its 10 ms F0 hop.

lookahead_ms.$comment: SVE lookahead (ms, P3-I0): template voices decode this much future context into every returned sample, at exactly this much latency; 0 = off; rounded up to 10 ms frames. Engine-shape change (restart).

rms_mix.$comment: RVC rms_mix_rate: 1 = the model's own envelope (off).

formant_semitones.$comment: Cepstral formant shift of the RVC path (formant_shift stays the tilt of the other modes).

silence_db.$comment: Silence-gate threshold, RMS dBFS (the legacy RMS skip 0.008 is -41.9 dBFS).

params_p0_new_fields.input_device: string, cpal input device name; '' = system default (today passed only to start_voice_changer)
params_p0_new_fields.rvc_consent_acknowledged: boolean, default false (replaces the webview localStorage key 'sigil.vc.consent')

params_p3_new_fields.slot_id: string, slot-store id of the selected voice; '' = a folder chosen directly (rvc_slot_dir)

params_p5_new_fields.reference_voice_id: string, voice-library id of a zero-shot voice's reference ('' = none; an invalid id is stored as ''). Per voice (slot.json); switch: a change loads the voice with that reference in the background

metrics_existing_fields.buffer_ms: number, output queue (deque + ring) in ms
metrics_existing_fields.process_ms: number, EMA of per-block processing time

metrics_p0_new_fields.process_p99_ms: number, p99 per-block processing time over the recent window
metrics_p0_new_fields.backlog_ms: number, captured audio waiting to be processed (input ring + pre-accumulator) in ms
metrics_p0_new_fields.dropped_ms: number, audio dropped by the latency budget since start
metrics_p0_new_fields.underruns: number, output callbacks that ran dry since start
metrics_p0_new_fields.ep: RustEpOutcome | null (src/types.ts; Rust diagnostics::EpOutcome) of the running model, null for classic / sidecar or when stopped

metrics_p3_new_fields.process_p50_ms: number | null, p50 per-block processing time
metrics_p3_new_fields.process_p95_ms: number | null, p95 per-block processing time
metrics_p3_new_fields.e2e_ms: number | null, estimated mic-to-speaker latency from the per-tick timeline
metrics_p3_new_fields.vram_mb: number | null, process VRAM held by the voice engine
metrics_p3_new_fields.levers: object | null, EffectiveLevers of the running engine: { <lever>: boolean, accelerator: 'none' | 'tensorrt_rtx' | 'dml_hp', precision, notes: string[] }

capabilities.$comment: voice_changer_get_capabilities (P3-S0). Every list holds contract values (normalized); the baseline values are always present.

families.$comment: P5 voice families (P5-S0; vc::families, TS ipc.ts VC_FAMILIES). capabilities.families lists every family: its FamilyInfo fields (flattened) plus available. slot_formats gains the formats of the families this build runs.

commands_p3.$comment: P3 voice-changer IPC (P3-S0; command names are also in plugin-commands/voice-changer.txt and ipc.ts VC_COMMANDS). Payloads snake_case, arguments camelCase.

commands_p5.$comment: P5 voice-changer IPC (P5-S0, scaffold; also in plugin-commands/voice-changer.txt and ipc.ts VC_COMMANDS). Payloads snake_case, arguments camelCase. Progress uses voice_changer:import_progress and cancel voice_changer_cancel_import { jobId }.
commands_p5.voice_changer_create_family_slot: { request: FamilySlotRequest { family, name?, reference_voice_id?, source?, options?, activate? } } -> VcImportResult (cached always false)
commands_p5.voice_changer_set_family_options: { id, options } -> SlotInfo (options normalized by the slot's family, stored as manifest.family)

commands.$comment: IPC semantics added by P0-A (recorded at P0 INTEGRATE). New voice_changer:error codes: device, monitor_unavailable, sidecar_connect, onnx_load, worker_error (engine stopped, except monitor_unavailable, which only loses the monitor). onnx_infer, sidecar_length, sidecar_exchange and rvc_convert now mean that block was muted, never dry input.
commands.set_voice_changer_params: Returns the effective VoiceChangerParams (not null) after Rust clamps and normalizes. On set, every params_p0_new_fields and params_p3_new_fields entry is optional: absent or null keeps the stored value; get_voice_changer_params always returns them.
commands.voice_changer:params: Event, payload VoiceChangerParams. Emitted when Rust changed what was sent, e.g. entering an RVC voice (another slot, or switching into RVC mode) whose <slot>/slot.json supplies pitch_semitones, formant_shift, index_rate, protect, pitch_extractor, speaker_id, rms_mix, formant_semitones and f0_range. TS treats the event as a trigger. It ignores it while its own set is in flight, and otherwise re-reads get_voice_changer_params, dropping that read if a set was sent meanwhile. TS serializes set_voice_changer_params (one in flight; the next payload is built after the previous reply is adopted).
commands.start_voice_changer: { inputDevice? }: when given, replaces and persists params.input_device ('' = system default); when absent, the stored input_device is used.
commands.persistence: Rust is authoritative: <app_data>/voice-changer/settings.json ({version: 1, params, outside_rvc?}; enabled is always saved false; the optional outside_rvc {pitch_semitones, formant_shift} object keeps the other modes' pitch and formant while RVC mode is active) and <slot>/slot.json for per-voice values. The TS service is not persisted (no patchService) and hydrates from get_voice_changer_params.
